Marcus / Hannah —

Thanks for the call notes. For clarity, Procurement is outlining the standard gating checklist and target SLA once we receive full submission (SOW + vendor packet + completed questionnaire):

Procurement gating (typical):
- Legal review / contract redlines: 10 business days from receipt of redline request (may be shorter if we accept your standard terms).
- Security intake: submit vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 report to Secure Intake Portal; security review 5 business days after submission (expedite possible for SOC 2 + clear responses).
- Finance: once legal and security sign-off, AP issues PO within 3 business days; if payment by card, AP requires spend approval and cardholder details but can often clear within 1–2 business days for lower amounts.

Required actions from Vendor (Redwood):
1) Complete attached vendor questionnaire (Procure_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx).
2) Provide current SOC 2 report (we accept the last 12 months).
3) Send standard remit-to and tax information (W-9 for US entities).

If you can deliver the vendor packet and completed questionnaire by Friday Oct 8, our current calendar puts PO issuance by Oct 20 assuming typical review timelines. If you prefer marketplace billing we can route, but procurement will still need vendor paperwork.

Regards,
ProcureOps Team
procureops@luminahealth.com
